description: Tails the osqueryd results log for processes, users and listening ports the light pack reports as added or removed.
name: osquery_feed

signals.description: osquery reported a process, user or listening port as added; medium severity for users and listeners, info for processes.
signals.name: osquery_added

signals.description: osquery reported a process, user or listening port as removed that this feed had filed or could have filed as added.
signals.name: osquery_removed
